ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones on lateral lobes, bisected by a central low-intensity black anchor-shaped region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. The left lobe contains a high density of discrete dark circular pixel blobs (mottling) within the white field, while the right lobe is predominantly solid white with sparse dark clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels. Serrations are more pronounced and closely spaced on the left trailing edge than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature tapering to acute, slightly upturned lateral tips, with a concave sweep along the posterior trailing edge toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of dark circular pixel clusters (rosettes) concentrated on the mid-to-outer left lobe. Isolated circular clusters are also visible on the medial portion of the right lobe near the central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-horizontal low-contrast linear pixel disruptions detected on the mid-posterior region of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor raggedness and irregular pixel-loss at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes, indicative of minor physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry characterized by the heavy 'peppered' appearance of the left lobe's white region compared to the relatively clean white surface of the right lobe.
